# Subroutine

Source: [1292](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1292); edited 2021-03-18. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1292-n1"></a>

- Subroutine events are manually triggered via Call Subroutine/Start Rule, cannot have conditions, and inherit calling rule context.

<a id="wiki-1292-n2"></a>

- Maximum 128 subroutines; a subroutine name can only be selected once in a project.
